content: Built-in materials (MeshLambertMaterial etc) have material.fog=true by default; fog shader chunks (fog_pars/fog_vertex/fog_fragment) are separate includes so onBeforeCompile patches to other chunks (e.g. normal_fragment_begin) do not disturb fog. scene.fog.color can be mutated per frame (fogColor uniform refreshed each render, no needsUpdate). Switching fog TYPE (Fog <-> FogExp2) or toggling fog on/off requires material.needsUpdate=true recompile - pick one fog type up front.
